test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bitmap_contains_32 ( bm AggregateFunction(groupBitmap, UInt32) ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE bitmap_contains_32_sparse ( name String, bm AggregateFunction(groupBitmap, UInt32) ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE bitmap_contains_random_keys ( key UInt32 ) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE bitmap_contains_sorted_keys ( key UInt32 ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bitmap_contains_32 SELECT groupBitmapState(toUInt32(number)) FROM numbers(1000000)

INSERT INTO bitmap_contains_32_sparse SELECT 'tiny', groupBitmapState(toUInt32(cityHash64(number))) FROM numbers(1000) UNION ALL SELECT 'sparse', groupBitmapState(toUInt32(cityHash64(number))) FROM numbers(100000)
INSERT INTO bitmap_contains_random_keys SELECT toUInt32(cityHash64(number + 1000000)) FROM numbers(8388608)
INSERT INTO bitmap_contains_sorted_keys SELECT toUInt32(number * 4096) FROM numbers(33554432)
test.query: WITH (SELECT bm FROM bitmap_contains_32) AS bm SELECT countIf(bitmapContains(bm, toUInt64(number % 1000000))) FROM numbers(150000000) FORMAT Null
WITH (SELECT bm FROM bitmap_contains_32) AS bm SELECT countIf(bitmapContains(bm, toUInt64(4294967296 + number % 1000000))) FROM numbers(150000000) FORMAT Null
WITH (SELECT bm FROM bitmap_contains_32_sparse WHERE name = 'tiny') AS bm SELECT sum(bitmapContains(bm, key)) FROM bitmap_contains_random_keys FORMAT Null
WITH (SELECT bm FROM bitmap_contains_32_sparse WHERE name = 'sparse') AS bm SELECT sum(bitmapContains(bm, key)) FROM bitmap_contains_random_keys FORMAT Null
WITH (SELECT bm FROM bitmap_contains_32_sparse WHERE name = 'tiny') AS bm SELECT sum(bitmapContains(bm, key)) FROM bitmap_contains_sorted_keys FORMAT Null
WITH (SELECT bm FROM bitmap_contains_32_sparse WHERE name = 'sparse') AS bm SELECT sum(bitmapContains(bm, key)) FROM bitmap_contains_sorted_keys FORMAT Null
